www-7393278.description: Welcome everyone, Old legend comes this summer with a new version of kogama wipeout, this will be fun! Kogama Wipeout SUMMER EDITION is the super fun 3D blocky running game in which you control block character taking part in a free running competition. You will be challenged with a course filled with many difficult obstacles to overcome, the course is set on a large lake so make sure not to fall into the drink. Link https://www.kogama.com/games/play/7393278/ The finish area will contain a flag and the winner will be the first person to reach it and lift the flag. The obstacles will range from rotating objects and hazardous lava so make sure to use your skills to the full extent. Good luck! Release Date Kogama Wipeout was initially released in June 2014 and was updated in September 2018. Developer Wipeout was developed by Kogama. Features Another Kogama game with a mission to reach the flag Big beautiful arena with water beneath it Free block building weapons to use Buyable various weapons and enhancements Platform This game is a web browser game. Categorization Action Games » Kogama Games » Kogama Wipeout More Information About Kogama Wipeout Kogama Wipeout is a high-quality kogama games game. This highly addictive action game is made with WebGL technology to run without trouble in most browsers. Controls WASD or arrow keys to control the character's movement Left click to shoot Hold left mouse button on a block to remove it Q to holster a weapon V to drop a weapon E to buy an item K to suicide
